messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(9 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The new check is turned on unconditionally for every subtest of every suite, and there is a class of fault-injection points it cannot account for, so it will report failures on subtests that are working as intended. It may be worth gating it behind an env variable (default off) until the known false positives are handled, so the whole matrix isn't affected while this is being tuned.

commit.subject: LU-16636 tests: catch unused fail_loc
commit.message:
LU-16636 tests: catch unused fail_loc

do extra check after each subtest to verify that fail_loc
is used. if fail_loc is set by a subtest, but not hit, then
something is wrong with the subtest?
